name: repeater-delays
comment: Row 1 (z = 0): four repeaters (93) facing +x (meta & 3 = 1) with delays 1, 2, 3, 4 (meta 1, 5, 9, 13) at x = -4..-1, wire at x = 0..2 after them; an active redstone torch (76) standing at x = -5 placed at t = 2 and removed at t = 30. The signal steps through the chain (updateTick schedules field_22023_b[d] * 2) and back off. Row 2 (z = 3): a floor lever (69) at x = -5 switched on at t = 5 and off at t = 6 by set_block (a one-tick input) into a delay-4 repeater (meta 13) at x = -4 and wire at x = -3..-1: the repeater turns on and holds for its delay. Row 3 (z = -3): a delay-1 repeater facing -x (meta 3) at x = 0 with wire on both sides, powered from x = 1 by a torch at x = 2 placed at t = 1 (reverse orientation, ignoreTick case 3). Power dumps at the block in front of every repeater each tick.
